brief:
The Palestine Center for Prisoner Studies said Israeli forces have killed dozens of detainees over the past three years and continue executing prisoners, the Shehab Wire reported. The center characterized the killings as part of an ongoing series of extrajudicial executions that has not abated despite international attention to detainee deaths in custody.

According to the center, the pattern of killings reflects what it described as international silence that has effectively encouraged further crimes against Palestinian detainees. The organization did not specify the total number of detainees killed or provide a detailed breakdown of individual cases, but framed the issue as a systemic problem requiring urgent international intervention and accountability measures.
title: Palestinian center accuses occupation of killing detainees amid international silence
